subject.title: feat(msteams): add native plugin interactivity parity

question: Should OpenClaw accept this new plugin-facing runtime.channel.msteams authority now, and if so what target-scoping, upgrade, and live-proof conditions are required before merge?
rationale: The PR expands plugin API and Teams Graph authority in a maintainer-labeled PR; deciding the permanent API/security boundary and whether to split or wait for the broader lane-interface direction is not a safe automation-only choice.

options.title: Repair and prove this Teams surface
options.body: Rebase the branch, fix the target-parsing and graphChannelId upgrade blockers, then require redacted live Teams tenant proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow or split behind the lane interface
options.body: Move only the minimum Teams fixes forward and defer broad runtime/API expansion to the lane-oriented channel interface work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/59986.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the PR open but paused until maintainers settle the Teams plugin authority model and live validation plan.

recommendation.title: Repair and prove this Teams surface
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, fix the target-parsing and graphChannelId upgrade blockers, then require redacted live Teams tenant proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history signal for the current route/plugin boundary and Teams store refactor seams that govern the API/security decision.
